headline.title: Lightscape at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
headline.body: A nightly walk-through light show among the garden's trees and paths, open now through Jan 3. Bundle up and book a timed ticket.

picks.title: Winter Lantern Festival, Queens
picks.body: Hand-built lantern displays light up Queens County Farm from 5 PM nightly. Last entry 9:30 PM. Runs through Jan 3.
picks.place: Queens County Farm Museum, Glen Oaks

picks.title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
picks.body: The Brooklyn Museum's show of the Dutch designer's couture, 140-plus pieces, closes Dec 6.

picks.title: The Photography Triennial: After Dark
picks.body: The Museum of the City of New York looks at the city's nightlife through contemporary photography. Opened Nov 20.
picks.place: Museum of the City of New York, East Harlem

picks.title: Lucy Dacus at Music Hall of Williamsburg
picks.body: The indie songwriter plays the 550-capacity Williamsburg room on Monday, Nov 30. Doors at 8 PM.

picks.title: LCD Soundsystem at Brooklyn Steel
picks.body: The band's annual NYC residency runs Nov 30 to Dec 3 at Brooklyn Steel, opening with the 100th show. Doors at 7 PM, 16+.

picks.title: Shop Small Greenpoint Fall Retail Crawl
picks.body: Pick up a passport at any participating shop and collect stamps across 60-plus Greenpoint businesses over nine days.

picks.title: SKATE at Domino Park
picks.body: Williamsburg's waterfront rink is open daily through Feb 21, with skyline views. Weekday admission is $13 for NYC residents.

picks.title: Citizen Kane in 35mm, 85th anniversary
picks.body: Nitehawk Williamsburg lists a 35mm screening of Welles's debut on Saturday, Nov 28. Check the site for showtimes and seats.

picks.title: Bryant Park Tree Lighting
picks.body: The park's Christmas tree is lit at 5:30 PM on Tuesday, Dec 1, with the Winter Village rink and shops already open around it.

picks.title: Brooklyn Flea Holiday Pop-Up, DUMBO
picks.body: Vintage, makers and gifts at 80 Pearl Street, opening Saturday, Nov 28 and running through Dec 20.

facts.t: Music Hall of Williamsburg, which opened as Northsix in 2001, loses its lease at the end of 2026 and will close, though shows are booked through the year.

countdowns.title: LCD Soundsystem 100th NYC residency show
countdowns.body: Brooklyn Steel, doors 7 PM, first of four nights through Dec 3.

countdowns.title: Bryant Park Tree Lighting
countdowns.body: Tuesday, Dec 1, 5:30 PM. Winter Village is open through Feb 28, 2027.

countdowns.title: Rockefeller Center Christmas tree lighting
countdowns.body: Wednesday, Dec 2, 7 to 10 PM. Not ticketed; view from the streets around the plaza.
